The '''SE-14r light repeating blaster''', sometimes referred to as the '''Imperial repeating pistol''', was an alternate model of [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]{{'}} [[SE-14 blaster pistol|SR combat pistol]] with fully automatic capabilities. Manufactured specifically for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it was carried as a sidearm by some [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] commanders.<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />

==Description==
The SE-14r light repeating blaster was an alternate model of the semi-automatic [[SE-14 blaster pistol|SR combat pistol]] used by the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] at the height of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] with fully automatic capabilities,<ref name="Forged in Battle" /> combining the portability and ease of use of a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] with a high rate of fire. However, this made it more likely to run out of ammo during an extended firefight or series of engagements,<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" /> and overheating stemming from prolonged discharges of the weapon could warp the SE-14r's barrel, causing potentially catastrophic malfunctions.<ref name="Forged in Battle" />

==History==
Although [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] created the SE-14r specifically for the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], some found their way onto the [[Black market/Legends|black market]], where they fetched a high price.<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" /> BlasTech later introduced the [[SE-14C blaster pistol/Legends|SE-14C blaster pistol]], which addressed the SE-14r's heat-management issues by integrating the [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]] into the back of the barrel.<ref name="Forged in Battle" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PlayStation 2]] versions of the ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''<ref name="Battlefront">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref> and ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'', some Imperial units carried the SE-14r as a sidearm, while it was replaced by the [[Scout trooper blaster pistol/Legends|scout trooper blaster pistol]] in the [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox|Xbox]] versions as well as the ''[[Star Wars Battlefront Classic Collection]]'' remasters.<ref name="Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

In ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''<ref name="Empire at War">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref> and its expansion, ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]'', oversized SE-14rs were carried by stormtroopers in urban, forest, swamp, and temperate environments, and by Imperial Field Commanders and [[scout trooper]]s in all environments.<ref name="Forces of Corruption">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>

The real life base gun for this was made from a Rexim Favor SMG and a 4x18 rifle scope (Ordinance Optics Inc.) was added on top. For Dr. Evazan's blaster a Model 7 Original 4x20 scope was added.
